item.title: Resident Evil Fans Will Regret Driving Away Zach Cregger
item.description: As the latest big-screen adaptation of the zombie video game series Resident Evil gears up for release next week, the film’s writer-director is dealing with a rabid horde of his own. While promoting the film, Zach Cregger has addressed the backlash his adaptation has received from fans over perceived creative liberties he’s taken with the franchise. item.title: US Open: Influencer Culture Has Turned It Into a Status Contest
item.description: They say you can tell a lot about a person by what appears on their social media feed. I am not sure what that says about me, since I see a lot of videos of wealthy, forlorn women explaining why they regret buying their Birkin handbags.
item.dc:creator: Allison Schrager

item.title: German Elections: AfD Win Puts Friedrich Merz On the Clock
item.description: The far-right AfD notched an electoral win that should put the nation’s current leadership on high alert.
item.dc:creator: Brooke Sample

item.title: Canada-EU Talks: Europe Has Far Too Many Hangers-On Already
item.description: Next week, Canadian Prime Minister Mark Carney will address the European Parliament in Strasbourg. We all know why. He’s been forced onto the defensive by a hyper-aggressive White House, and has said his response will be to “build a much stronger and deeper security and economic partnership” with the European Union.
item.dc:creator: Mihir Sharma

item.title: Trump's Map Obsession Keeps Leading the US Astray
item.description: The African diplomats who drafted a recent resolution by the United Nations to “Correct the Map” of the world made a tactical error when they oversold their bit of common sense with flamboyant claims to “cognitive justice and memorial reparation.”
item.dc:creator: Andreas Kluth
